claude_proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.spell_save_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The staff's automatic once-per-dawn protection listens for a failed save against a qualifying spell without consuming a reaction. Existing non-spell passive operations only support elapsed-time cadence, and `triggered_reaction` would falsely consume a reaction.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: upgrade_triggering_save_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The missing mechanic is not spell negation or reflection; it rewrites the triggering saving throw result from failure to success so the triggering spell resolves through its success branch.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one.
